links: Dense air (1.6 bar) increases drag, making sustained flight costly.
Herds move constantly across meadows and shores.
High drag favors short bursts and hovering over gliding.
Broad wings provide high lift at low speeds for quick maneuvers.

skill.effect: Hold position over a target; +5 Charm.

observe: Watch it hover over a fleeing Rondo.

journal.en: Wings beat hard, defying the heavy air to hover just inches from fur.

plausibility.summary: Treat Hover as burst positioning (seconds) between perches on the host; primary locomotion is hop/cling along the flank. Retune weakness to F19 (1.6× wind force on ridges/shore), not D19.

links: Cleaner must cling to moving, shaggy hosts.
Zygodactyl feet offer four-point contact and secure locking.

skill.effect: Lock onto host; immune to knockdown; +5 Befriend.

journal.en: Feet grip the shaggy flank like hooks, riding out the herd's panic.

plausibility.summary: D29 ectoparasites on dense herds and 1.05 g (D6/F2) favor secure grip on moving, panicking hosts. Zygodactyl (two toes forward, two back) plus tendon locking is standard in Piciformes and gives four-point contact on fur and hide—mechanically matched to the cling-defence niche.
fixes: D29 ectoparasites on dense herds and 1.05 g (D6/F2) favor secure grip on moving, panicking hosts. Zygodactyl (two toes forward, two back) plus tendon locking is standard in Piciformes and gives four-point contact on fur and hide—mechanically matched to the cling-defence niche.

analogues.organism: Oxpeckers (Buphagus spp.) and woodpeckers (Picidae)—zygodactyl feet and hallux locking for clinging to substrates including living hosts.

links: Bill must probe without harming host.
Dense air dampens high-frequency sound, favoring tactile cues.
Bill tip detects host hair movement and parasite thrashing.

skill.effect: Remove parasites; heals host 5 HP, yields 2 DNA.

chains.weakness: Bill breaks on bone if host moves too fast.

journal.en: The bill slips through fur like a needle, finding parasites by touch.

plausibility.summary: Optionally drop the acoustic-dampening rationale; root chain in D29 (parasite load) + host safety (non-penetrating groom) is sufficient.

links: Hosts must recognize cleaner as beneficial.
High UV (F1) selects for UV-reflective feathers.
Bright signals advertise health and parasite-free status.

skill.effect: Flash wings at host; +10 Befriend, reveals parasites.

journal.en: A flash of blue and red signals the giant: I am the cleaner, not the killer.

secrets: Nest woven from shed Rondo hair and sea grass.
Albino variant has pale yellow feathers and avoids red-veined plants.
moments: On the shore at spring low tide, a Coloso stands knee-deep in the surge. The Bello-pico flits up its massive neck, and the giant closes its eyes, swaying gently as the little bird works, trusting a creature it could crush.

journal.en: It rides the Rondo's flank, picking ticks with precise strokes.
A tiny bodyguard for a tax of bugs.
